theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_covering_liminf_majorant
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace Y] (ν : Measure Y) (d : ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (F : Y → Set X) (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (g : ℕ → Y → ℝ≥0∞) (b : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (L : ℝ≥0∞), Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ i, Measurable (g i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (y : Y), c * (⨅ (t : ℕ → Set X) (_ : F y ⊆ ⋃ n, t n) (_ : ∀ n, ediam (t n) ≤ r i), ∑' n, ⨆ (_ : (t n).Nonempty), ediam (t n) ^ d) ≤ g i y) → (∀ i, ∫⁻ y, g i y ∂ν ≤ b i) → Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 L) → ∃ G : Y → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable G ∧ (∀ y, c * μH[d] (F y) ≤ G y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, G y ∂ν ≤ L
